title: Fault-Class-Matched Test Oracles for Output-Invisible Quantum Transpiler Regressions
abstract: arXiv:2609.24230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test oracles for quantum transpilers typically judge correctness by comparing compiled output against a reference: a statevector, a sampled distribution, or a unitary compared modulo global phase. A companion empirical study measures how often that choice fails. Roughly 28% of merged Qiskit transpiler bug-fixes (95% Wilson CI 19-40%) repair a fault that corrupts layout metadata, global phase, or run-to-run reproducibility while output stays correct: invisible to a black-box output-equivalence oracle by construction. This paper closes that gap with a fault-class-matched, layout-aware, width-tiered oracle family: a layout/permutation contract checker and a contract-level metamorphic relation (MR-1) for the metadata channel, a global-phase tracker for the phase channel, and a determinism runner for reproducibility. translated_title: 面向输出不可见量子转译器回归的故障类别匹配测试预言
translated_abstract: 量子转译器的测试预言通常通过将编译输出与参考对象进行对比来判断正确性：参考对象可以是态矢量、采样分布，或在忽略全局相位意义下比较的幺正矩阵。一项配套的实证研究测量了这种做法失效的频率：在已合并的 Qiskit 转译器缺陷修复中，约有 28%（95% Wilson 置信区间为 19–40%）所修复的缺陷会破坏布局元数据、全局相位或运行间可复现性，而输出本身仍然正确——这类缺陷从构造上就对黑盒输出等价性预言不可见。本文以一族故障类别匹配、布局感知、按位宽分层的预言机来弥补这一空白：针对元数据通道，提供布局/置换契约检查器与契约级蜕变关系（MR-1）；针对相位通道，提供全局相位跟踪器；针对可复现性，提供确定性运行器。通过对九个真实的、已合并的 Qiskit 转译器回归（每个通道三个）从源码进行验证，输出等价性预言机……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 约28%的Qiskit转译器缺陷修复会破坏布局元数据、全局相位或运行间可复现性而输出仍正确，对传统输出等价性测试预言不可见；本文提出故障类别匹配、布局感知、按位宽分层的预言机家族（布局/置换契约检查器与蜕变关系MR-1、全局相位跟踪器、确定性运行器），以检测这类“输出不可见”回归。
en_tdlr: About 28% of merged Qiskit transpiler bug-fixes corrupt layout metadata, global phase, or reproducibility while the output stays correct—making them invisible to output-equivalence oracles; this paper introduces a fault-class-matched, layout-aware, width-tiered oracle family (a layout/permutation contract checker with metamorphic relation MR-1, a global-phase tracker, and a determinism runner) to catch such output-invisible regressions.
